mapper.insert: insert into housesell(id, title, date, type, price, admin_price, admin_desc, room_type, floor_now, floor_tot, size, content, keyword, address, detail_address, lat, lng) values (#{id},#{title},now(), #{type},#{price},#{admin_price},#{admin_desc},#{room_type},#{floor_now},#{floor_tot},#{size},#{content},#{keyword},#{address},#{detail_address}, #{lat}, #{lng})
mapper.select: select count(*) as cnt from housesell
